item.title: Murph asks less before it helps
item.summary: When you set a goal or start an experiment, Murph now proposes a starting plan after two or three questions and asks only for what it cannot look up.
item.details: Sending something for you, spending money, booking, and anything that cannot be undone still wait for your yes. If you put off connecting a device, Murph leaves it alone until you bring it up.
